acceptedAnswer.text: For simple plug-in or battery-operated under-cabinet lighting, a DIY approach might be feasible. However, for hardwired systems that require connecting to your home's electrical system, it is highly recommended to hire a licensed contractor. This ensures the installation is safe, up to code, and properly integrated, preventing potential electrical hazards.
